_meta.description: Strict integration rules and compatibility matrices between infrastructures and frameworks. AI agents MUST follow these instructions to prevent build errors and architectural mismatches.

matrices.rule: In Next.js App Router, any component accessing Zustand stores MUST include the 'use client' directive at the very top of the file. Server Components cannot read Zustand state.
For Zustand stores that need to be shared across the application, create a store provider pattern in a client component to avoid multiple store instances during SSR.

When using GSAP in Next.js (App Router), the component MUST be marked with 'use client'. Use React 'useRef' for DOM elements and wrap all animations inside the '@gsap/react' hook 'useGSAP()' which handles cleanup automatically.
For ScrollTrigger or ScrollSmoother plugins in Next.js, register them inside a 'use client' component and check for 'window' object existence before registration to prevent SSR errors.
Framer Motion components MUST be used within a 'use client' directive in Next.js App Router. Re-export motion components from a client component file to use them in Server Components.

For React Three Fiber in Next.js, the Canvas component and all 3D components MUST be marked with 'use client'. Use Next.js dynamic imports with '{ ssr: false }' to prevent 'document is not defined' errors during server-side rendering.
When using Three.js add-ons (like three/examples/jsm), configure Next.js to handle CommonJS/ESM mismatches in the webpack config or use a compatible version.

React components imported into Astro (Islands) MUST be rendered with a client directive (e.g., 'client:load', 'client:visible', 'client:idle') for interactivity. Without directives, they render as static HTML and state will not work.
For React components that should only render on the client (e.g., those using 'window' or 'document'), use 'client:only="react"' directive to skip server-side rendering.
Vue components in Astro MUST use client directives (e.g., 'client:load', 'client:visible') to become interactive islands. Without directives, they render as static HTML.
Svelte components in Astro MUST use client directives (e.g., 'client:load', 'client:visible') to become interactive islands. Without directives, they render as static HTML.

For Tailwind CSS v4 in Astro, the preferred method is using the official Vite plugin from Tailwind. The '@astrojs/tailwind' integration is deprecated for Tailwind 4 and should only be used for Tailwind 3 projects.

In Nuxt 3, to prevent memory leaks, GSAP animations MUST be initialized inside the 'onMounted' lifecycle hook. The GSAP context MUST be reverted (ctx.revert() or useGSAP cleanup) inside 'onBeforeUnmount'.
For Nuxt 3, create a client-side plugin (e.g., 'plugins/gsap.client.ts') to register GSAP plugins globally and make them available throughout the application.
In Nuxt 3, Pinia MUST be installed via '@pinia/nuxt' module (npx nuxi@latest module add pinia). Pinia v3 only supports Vue 3 and Nuxt 3+ and requires TypeScript 5+.

For SSR with Pinia in Nuxt 3, avoid storing non-serializable data (like class instances, functions) in stores. Pinia handles SSR serialization/hydration automatically when using the '@pinia/nuxt' module.
Nuxt 3+ is based on Vue 3. Use Composition API as the recommended way to write components. Vuex is deprecated; Pinia is the official state management solution.
For SvelteKit projects, install Tailwind CSS via '@tailwindcss/vite' plugin. Add the Vite plugin to your 'vite.config.js' and import the Tailwind CSS file in your app's CSS entry.
In Svelte/SvelteKit, GSAP animations MUST be initialized inside the 'onMount' lifecycle hook to ensure the DOM is available. Use 'onDestroy' to clean up GSAP contexts and prevent memory leaks.
Avoid using $effect for GSAP animations in Svelte 5 as it can cause infinite re-renders. Use onMount instead for animations that should only run once.
Do NOT manipulate the DOM directly with vanilla Three.js methods in a React environment. You MUST use '@react-three/fiber' (Canvas) and '@react-three/drei' hooks declaratively.
Use the official React integration for Swiper (import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react'). Do NOT import core modules directly into the DOM.
For Zustand with React, the store can be a global singleton. To avoid unnecessary re-renders, use selectors to subscribe only to specific state slices.
Pinia v3 only supports Vue 3 and requires TypeScript 5+. Vuex is maintenance-only and should not be used in new projects.
In Vue 3, GSAP animations MUST be initialized inside the 'onMounted' lifecycle hook. Use 'onBeforeUnmount' to clean up GSAP contexts and prevent memory leaks.

For .NET 8.0 Web API with SQL Server, use Entity Framework Core Design packages. Employ Code-First approach for migrations. DbContext MUST be configured in 'Program.cs' using 'builder.Services.AddDbContext'.
To prevent N+1 query problems and performance issues, use 'Include()' for eager loading or 'Select()' for projection. Be cautious with lazy loading as it can cause multiple database round-trips.
For MongoDB with .NET 8, use the official 'MongoDB.EntityFrameworkCore' provider (version 8.0+) which is fully compatible with Entity Framework Core 8 and .NET 8.

For Redis caching in .NET 8 Web API, use 'Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.StackExchangeRedis' package. Implement cache-aside pattern: check Redis first, fallback to database, and cache results with appropriate expiration.
For Node.js with MongoDB, use Mongoose ODM for schema-based modeling. Define clear schemas with validation, type casting, and business logic hooks.
For Mongoose with Express, define schemas before models. Use 'mongoose.connect()' with connection options for proper error handling and connection management.
For Prisma with Node.js, generate the Prisma Client after defining the schema. Use 'npx prisma generate' and 'npx prisma migrate dev' for database migrations.
For Socket.io with Node.js, initialize the Socket.io server with CORS options configured. Use 'socket.io-client' on the frontend with the same version as the server.

Next.js 15 varsayılan olarak Tailwind CSS v4 kurar. tailwind.config.js dosyası artık kullanılmaz, tema token'ları @theme ile CSS içinde tanımlanır. Eski projelerde tailwind.config.ts varsa, Tailwind v3'e downgrade yap veya konfigürasyonu CSS tabanlı yapıya migrate et.
@react-three/fiber v8, React 19 ile çalışmaz. React 19 ve Next.js 15 için @react-three/fiber@rc (v9 RC) sürümünü kullan.
@astrojs/tailwind eklentisi Tailwind CSS v4 için deprecated durumundadır. Tailwind v4 için resmi Vite plugin'ini (@tailwindcss/vite) kullan. Astro 5.2+ üzerinde 'npx astro add tailwind' çalıştır.
client:only directive'i, React component'ini sadece client'ta render eder ve SSR'ı tamamen bypass eder. Sadece client'ta çalışması gereken component'ler için client:only="react" kullan.

Pinia store'larını modül seviyesinde çağırma (global singleton pattern). SSR'de store'ları fonksiyon içinde çağır ve pinia instance'ını geç. @pinia/nuxt modülü SSR serialization/hydration'ı otomatik yönetir.

CDN ile birlikte Nuxt 3 kullanırken, Pinia state'i __NUXT_DATA__ içinde serialized olur. CDN bu sayfayı cache'lerse, diğer kullanıcılar başkasının state'ini görebilir (cache poisoning). Bu durumda CDN cache'ini devre dışı bırak veya kullanıcıya özel cache stratejisi uygula.
Tailwind CSS v4'te tailwind.config.js dosyası kullanılmaz. SvelteKit'te @tailwindcss/vite eklentisini kullan ve src/app.css'ye '@import "tailwindcss";' ekle.
GSAP kodlarını asla modül seviyesinde veya load() fonksiyonu içinde çalıştırma (SSR hatası verir). Tüm animasyonları onMount içinde başlat ve onDestroy'de GSAP Context'i temizle (ctx.revert()).
Solid.js projesinde Tailwind CSS'i PostCSS eklentisi olarak entegre et. postcss.config.js içinde @tailwind/postcss'i ekle. SolidStart'te ise Vite plugin'ini kullan.
@tailwindcss/vite sürüm 4.0.8 ve üzerinde Qwik projelerinde sınıfların düzgün render olmaması sorunu var. Sürümü 4.0.7'ye sabitle.
Deno Fresh için resmi @fresh/plugin-tailwind paketi sadece Tailwind CSS v3'ü destekliyor. Tailwind v4 için @pakornv/fresh-plugin-tailwindcss gibi community çözümlerine ihtiyaç var.
Pinia setup store'larında tüm state property'lerini setup fonksiyonundan return et. Return edilmeyen state'ler SSR'de çalışmaz, Vue DevTools'ta görünmez ve Pinia plugin'leri ile uyumlu olmaz.
SSR'de Date, Set, Map gibi non-serializable veri tiplerini Pinia store'unda tutma. Bu tipler serialization hatasına yol açar. devalue veya benzeri bir kütüphane ile güvenli serialization yap.
@react-three/fiber v8, React 19 ile uyumlu değil. React 19 kullanıyorsan @react-three/fiber@rc (v9 RC) sürümüne geç. R3F v9, async initialization gerektirir.
React 19 ile Tailwind CSS v4 kullanılıyorsa, PostCSS üzerinden entegrasyon yap. tailwind.config.js dosyası yok, tema @theme ile CSS'de tanımlanır.
